scripts.build: npm run content:build && next build && node scripts/build-markdown.mjs
scripts.preview: npm run content:build && opennextjs-cloudflare build && opennextjs-cloudflare preview
scripts.deploy: npm run content:build && opennextjs-cloudflare build && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy && npm run indexnow && npm run search:sync && npm run search:check -- --wait
scripts.search:sync: wrangler ai-search jobs create ahromlabs-search --description "Post-deploy sync" || echo "AI Search sync not started; the 6-hourly scheduled sync will pick the changes up"
